themeCards.title: A $6bn buyback still left the 10-year at a 2023 high
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 今日图表: US 10-year yields touched their highest since 2023 after the Treasury buyback disappointed. U.S. Treasury: the official 9 September curve printed 4.83% on the 10-year, 4.43% on the 2-year, and 5.28% on the 30-year. CNBC: the 10-year traded 4.845%, the highest since 1 November 2023 at 4.935%, and Bessent’s long-end buyback is $6bn. 华尔街见闻: the S&P 500 closed at 7636.36, down 0.48%.
themeCards.mechanism: A $6bn operation that still sat at the low end of Street hopes left official 10-year yields at 4.83%, so 0.48% on the S&P is a term-premium sell rather than a growth scare. CICC (24 August): the 10-year problem is term premium — willingness to hold the bond — rather than the hike path. PPI at 20:30 Beijing today is the next print.

themeCards.title: Tanker strikes put Brent back through $101.21
themeCards.fact: WRAL AP: Brent settled at $101.21, up 3.4%, the first close above $100 since July, after the US destroyed five Iranian tankers. 财经早茶 能源: Brent broke $101 as the Iran war hit tankers. EIA: August Brent averaged $91, inventories are down 400 million barrels this year, and US distillate stocks are forecast to drop below 100 million barrels in September.
themeCards.mechanism: A $101.21 settle on tanker hits is a Hormuz supply print sitting on already-thin distillate. CICC (20 July): demand destruction already caps how long a war premium can sit. PPI at 20:30 Beijing today, through the energy line, is the next print.

themeCards.title: China CPI and PPI printed the imported energy pulse
themeCards.fact: NBS: August CPI rose 0.8% y/y. NBS: August PPI rose 3.8% y/y. 第一财经: energy CPI jumped to 4.1% from 0.6% and added 0.28pp to the headline. 财新: core remains soft even as energy and nonferrous prices lifted the prints.
themeCards.mechanism: A 0.8% CPI print and a 3.8% PPI print are the onshore tape of the same energy pulse that sold US cash. CICC (6 September): they already had August inflation edging higher before this release. The 金融强国 briefing at 15:00 Beijing today is the next print.

themeCards.title: European stocks sold the ECB hike that prints today
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 欧洲股债: European government-bond yields jumped and stocks fell as traders raised ECB hike bets. 华尔街见闻: the Stoxx 600 closed down 1.41%, the largest drop since July, with the FTSE 100 down 1.31% at 10670.06. Destatis: the August CPI flash was +2.9%, and finals are due today.
themeCards.mechanism: A 1.41% Stoxx drop into a widely expected 25bp deposit-rate move is the oil-inflation premium landing on Bunds and European equities together. Destatis finals at 14:00 Beijing and the ECB deposit rate at 20:15 settle it.

themeCards.title: London copper made another record on a refined-copper tariff
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 金属: copper made another record on a US refined-copper tariff and supply tightness, and gold’s gain narrowed. 华尔街见闻: LME three-month copper traded as high as 14858.5 a tonne, and COMEX printed $6.894 a pound.

factSources.label: 华尔街见闻 铜纪录

themeCards.mechanism: A 14858.5 record is a refined-copper tariff squeeze plus mine tightness, a different mechanism from Hormuz oil. CICC (5 August): mine-supply growth is turning negative while a US refined-copper tariff remains in play. US CPI on 11 September is the next print.

themeCards.title: The yen strengthened a third day toward 153.65
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 外汇: the yen strengthened versus the dollar for a third day. 华尔街见闻: USD/JPY printed 153.65. Cointelegraph: the yen held around 153, the strongest since February, as Bessent kept intervention risk live.
themeCards.mechanism: A 153.65 print on a third stronger session is still an intervention-and-BOJ squeeze. Morgan Stanley (9 September): yen strength alone does not unwind EM carry while global growth and equities still hold. The BOJ decision on 17–18 September is the settle.

themeCards.title: Gold ETFs took $18bn while bitcoin failed $80,000
themeCards.fact: World Gold Council: August gold ETFs took in US$18bn, holdings rose to 4,189 tonnes, and AUM reached US$615bn. Cointelegraph: bitcoin failed to reclaim $80,000. 华尔街见闻: bitcoin was about 7.82万美元. 律动: SOPR printed 1.002, a third week above 1.
themeCards.mechanism: August gold ETF inflows beside bitcoin failing $80,000 is duration-beta into Friday’s CPI, and a SOPR print of 1.002 says the coins that moved were still in profit. CPI on 11 September is the next print.

globalImplies.text: Do not read $101.21 as a finished Hormuz shutdown. Distillate below 100 million barrels is the tighter domestic print under that settle.
CICC (20 July): demand destruction already caps how long a war premium can sit, which is why a $101.21 settle can coexist with an EIA August average of $91.
